title: THE BULLY’S DEBT IS FINALLY SETTLED! 🛴

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: YOU TOLD THE PRINCIPAL EVERYTHING AND NOW MY ENTIRE LIFE IS OVER BECAUSE OF YOU!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I didn't say a single word to anyone [beat] because I knew your secret would come out eventually without me having to say a thing.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Then how did Principal Huda find that stolen Midnight Scooter [beat] hidden inside my gym locker if you weren't the one who snitched?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I didn't find a stolen scooter in your locker, Bruno [beat] I found a legal receipt showing the item was paid for in full by Nix.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You see, Bruno, I didn't want you to go to jail for a stupid prank [beat] so I bought the scooter from the owner before the police arrived.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: But I broke the handle and scratched the paint [beat] I thought you hated me for what I did to your little sister's bicycle last summer.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I realized that the only reason you act like a monster [beat] is because nobody has ever shown you what it feels like to have a real ally.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nix had spent his entire summer job money [beat] just to keep his worst enemy from getting a permanent criminal record at only sixteen.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You actually spent your college savings [beat] just to save the guy who made your life a living nightmare for three whole years, Nix?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The look on your face right now is worth every penny [beat] because now you owe me a lifetime of being a decent human being to everyone.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Since the scooter belongs to Nix now [beat] there are no theft charges, but you still have three weeks of detention for the school break-in.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Thank you, Nix [beat] I promise I will never lay a finger on anyone in this school ever again for as long as I live, I truly mean it.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Don't thank me yet [beat] you're going to spend your entire weekend helping me and Joy repaint the school cafeteria for no pay at all.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how Nix proved [beat] that in this world, kindness is the only currency that actually buys you a completely clean slate.
